summary: Install the correct Steam application and check access, system requirements, language support, and your linked login identity.

topic.alt: A group of characters facing a large purple creature in an official AION 2 Steam screenshot.

workflow.title: Install the main game with the right access
workflow.caption: Identify the application, then check access separately from installation.

steps.label: Choose the main application
steps.description: AION 2 is App 3393110. AION 2 Playtest, App 4972320, is a separate entry.

steps.label: Check the access period
steps.description: Advance Access requires eligibility; public opening is scheduled for October 5 at 13:00 UTC.

steps.label: Install and finish updates
steps.description: Use the intended Steam account and a drive with sufficient free space; finish the current download and patches.

steps.label: Launch with that identity
steps.description: Start the main-game Library entry. Keep Steam as the playing identity when checking account links and rewards.
